component.name: AbraFlexi ISDS
component.summary: Synchronize Czech ISDS data messages to AbraFlexi Events

description.p: abraflexi-isds logs in to a Czech ISDS (Informační systém datových schránek / Data Box) account, fetches received data messages, and creates an AbraFlexi Event (evidence "udalost") for each message not synced yet. Message documents are attached to the Event, and the sender is linked to a matching AbraFlexi Adresar record when its IČO can be resolved from the ISDS directory.
